description:
3D texture painting; an open-source, modern texture painting application, built in pure Rust

TextureCraft is a fast, open-source 3D texture painting workflow: paint PBR materials straight onto your models in layers with masks, bake mesh maps, drive smart materials from them and export textures for any engine. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.

- Familiar: texture sets, a layer stack with per-channel blending, masks and generators, smart materials, the tool shelf, the 3D and 2D views.
- Fast: a tiled, copy-on-write texel engine on every CPU core and a wgpu viewport (Vulkan, Metal, DX12, WebGPU). Mesh maps bake on the GPU about 12x faster than on the CPU, and 8K texture sets stay responsive while you paint.
- Seamless: brush stamps live on the 3D surface, so strokes flow across UV seams, and the camera's visibility keeps paint off the back of your model.
- Open: glTF/GLB, FBX, COLLADA, USD, Alembic, OBJ, PLY and STL in; PNG, JPEG, TGA, TIFF, BMP, WEBP, EXR and HDR textures out at 8, 16 or 32 bits, with UDIM tiles; textured OBJ, GLB and USD mesh export.
- Agent-native: every menu item and tool is a command you can drive from the CLI, a JSON control channel or an MCP server.
